item.title: Imminent collapse of churchyard wall next to pavement along A21 Bromley Common, 18th September
item.description:
The flint perimeter wall between Holy Trinity Churchyard and the A21 has lost a large quantity of stone from the inside, such that there is now a visible hole extending through the wall. There appears to be a very real risk of the wall collapsing if this is not rectified quickly. Such a collapse would constitute a danger to passing pedestrians given the significant drop in level between the footpath and the churchyard. There are other places around the perimeter where the wall has suffered the loss of stones, mostly due to age and invasive plant growth, some due to malicious activity, but this is the most serious concern.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): A21, Bromley Common, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
